scenarios.title: Published Figure 7 reference trajectory
scenarios.description: Reproduces the authors' human Figure 7 parameter preset, including the modeled insulin-sensitivity target transition at day 1100.

scenarios.title: No sensitivity-recovery control
scenarios.description: Keeps the pre-transition insulin-sensitivity target after day 1100. This is a computational control, not a clinical untreated arm.

scenarios.title: Earlier sensitivity transition
scenarios.description: Moves the model's insulin-sensitivity transition to day 730 while keeping the Figure 7 target values. Timing is an exploratory perturbation.

scenarios.title: Later sensitivity transition
scenarios.description: Moves the model's insulin-sensitivity transition to day 1460 while keeping the Figure 7 target values. Timing is an exploratory perturbation.

model: Ha–Satin–Sherman Type 2 diabetes pathogenesis model (human Figure 7 preset)

reference.authors: Ha J, Satin LS, Sherman AS
reference.title: A Mathematical Model of the Pathogenesis, Prevention, and Reversal of Type 2 Diabetes
